gaps: omega-yaml carries a key's value only when it is a plain or quoted scalar, so `script: |`, `extends: *base` and any key set to a block scalar or an alias arrive with no value and nothing is stated about what they are set to; a merge key (`<<: *defaults`) is not expanded either, so the keys a job inherits from an anchor are not declared where they are merged
`include: - project: group/app` and the `file:` beside it are stated separately: a YAML sequence item is not itself a fact, so which included file comes from which project is not stated
hidden dot-prefixed templates are stated as Job entities so that `extends` resolves; whether one is runnable is not stated
`rules:`/`only:`/`except:` conditions, `parallel: matrix:` expansion, generated child pipelines and runner state need evidence outside the file
